findings.note: Baker Mayfield (foot, already missed 3 games with a dislocated thumb) missed Wednesday, was limited Thursday-Friday and is questionable; rookie Jalon Daniels would start if he sits. Detroit has lost Hutchinson (ACL) and Jack Campbell (neck) but gets S Kerby Joseph back.

Friday's official report rules out Bucs S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) and CB Josh Hayes (knee), which thins the secondary against Detroit's offense. OLB Yaya Diaby is questionable after a full Friday practice; Lions C Cade Mays is out and four Lions DBs/LBs are questionable.

ESPN game page shows Tampa 3-6 against Detroit 7-2 (5-0 at home) going for a sixth straight win, with Hutchinson on IR. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Tampa Bay a 38.6% chance to win straight up. The game is indoors at Ford Field.
